text.description_html:
KABA 8148S26D Simplex Keypad Mortise Lever Lock with Key Override

The KABA Simplex 8148S Heavy Duty Keypad Mortise Entry Lever Lock, Passage Function, Lockout feature and Key Override. KABA Simplex models are well known for their durability, strong rugged design and construction. Entry Function Lockset - Unlock door with the pushbutton keypad or with the Key override. Easy to install, program and maintain.

Passage feature allows unrestricted door entry when desired. Turning the included interior key or thumbturn, disengages the exterior Keypad, so no code is needed to open the door.

Lockout (Privacy) feature allows you to disable the lock from the inside so that the keypad entry codes can not be used to gain access. When the lockout feature is enabled, access is only permitted using the key override.

Limit access to high-traffic, security-sensitive areas in commercial, institutional, industrial, government and military buildings. Ideal for locations with frequent personal turnover such as data processing centers, employee entrances, motels, dormitories, volunteer fire departments, airports and hospitals.

Features of the KABA Simplex 8148S26D

  • Includes Lockout (Privacy) Feature
  • Includes Passage Feature
  • Key Override Schlage "C" Keyway Interchangeable Core I/C (Less Core)
  • Easy to maintain - no batteries to replace.
  • Durable heavy-duty construction.
  • Single access code—one easy to manage code for all users
  • Easily programmed via keypad without removing lock from the door
  • Highly weather resistant
  • Heavy Duty - ANSI/BHMA Grade 1 (highest grade)
  • ADA Compliant
